title: Flow Sequence: Allow to select/deselect RTP stream by clicking on it
description:
Change fulfills #16552 requirements.
A user can select/deselect RTP streams from Voip Calls/Flow Sequence dialog
in RTP Streams dialog. When RTP stream in Flow Sequence dialog is selected
(by menu or shortcut), RTP Stream dialog is shown on background and stream
is marked as selected (or selection is cleared). The user than can analyse
selected RTP streams by tools in RTP Streams dialog.

Changes by this merge request:
* sequence_analysis
  - added posibility to attach custom info to every item and free it on release
    - added item info_type and info_ptr to seq_analysis_item_t
  - it allows any developer to extend sequence diagrams in future
* Voip Calls dialog and RTP Streams dialog are singletons now
  - They can be opened only once. If menu action issued again, dialog is
    just focused.
  - Voip Calls dialog pass signals for selecting/deselecting streams from
    Sequence dialog to Main window. Signals are then passed to RTP Streams
    dialog then.
  - Signal for opening RTP Streams dialog is passed thru Voip Calls dialog
    to Main window too

changes_data.diff:
@@ -360,6 +360,28 @@
     <string>P</string>
    </property>
   </action>
+  <action name="actionSelectRtpStream">
+   <property name="text">
+    <string>Select RTP Stream</string>
+   </property>
+   <property name="toolTip">
+    <string>Select RTP stream in RTP Streams dialog</string>
+   </property>
+   <property name="shortcut">
+    <string>S</string>
+   </property>
+  </action>
+  <action name="actionDeselectRtpStream">
+   <property name="text">
+    <string>Deselect RTP Stream</string>
+   </property>
+   <property name="toolTip">
+    <string>Deselect RTP stream in RTP Streams dialog</string>
+   </property>
+   <property name="shortcut">
+    <string>D</string>
+   </property>
+  </action>
  </widget>
  <customwidgets>
   <customwidget>

commits_data.title: voip_calls_dialog/voip_calls: Fix for #16952
commits_data.message:
voip_calls_dialog/voip_calls: Fix for #16952

The fix solves issue #16952. It reverts commit 88813716 which introduced memory leak which causes the issue. The original issue with duplicating entries is solved too.
Because commit was cherry picked to 3.4.0 (might be in more branches), this patch should be cherry picked too.
